chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar asked his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar, peace be upon them:
About a man: may he lead the people in salat (prayer) while he is wearing trousers and a cloak? He said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.بِالْقَوْمِ: with the people, meaning as their prayer leader in congregation
key_terms.رِدَاءٌ: a cloak or upper wrap garment
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible
key_terms.يُصَلِّي: to perform salat (prayer), here meaning to lead the prayer

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to lead congregational salat while wearing trousers and a cloak?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning leading congregational salat (prayer). It indicates that there is no objection to a man leading the people in salat while wearing sarāwīl and a ridāʾ.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1133 - Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as)

about a man leading a group in prayer while wearing trousers (sarawil) and a cloak (rida).
He (as) replied: "There is no harm in it”.
